ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all Business Administration majors on May 3, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Finance major and Informatics Minor students on Monday, May 10, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 27, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
